## Organization
KosovoScores is the ultimate destination for real-time football scores, standings, and match updates from Superliga, Liga e Pare and Kupa e Kosoves. Based in Kosovo, covering all local Kosovo football leagues with live scores, fixtures, tables, top scorers, week stars and news.

## Site sections
- / — Live scores dashboard (today's matches across all leagues)
- /ligat — All competitions / leagues
- /ligat/:id — League detail (standings, fixtures, results)
- /ndeshja/:slug — Match detail (live score, timeline, lineups, stats)
- /top-scorers — Top goalscorers across leagues
- /yjet-e-javes — Week stars (player of the week)
- /kalendar — Match calendar (next 30 days)
- /lajme — Football news
- /live-scores — Live scores overview

## Notes
- Primary language: Albanian (sq)
- Match URLs use slugs: /ndeshja/{hometeam}-vs-{awayteam}-{yyyy-mm-dd}
- Sitemap: https://kosovoscores.com/sitemap.xml
